component.description:
What it does Sends a prompt to a large language model and returns the reply. This is the one component for every model in the platform's model catalogue, rather than one component per model.

How it works Pick a provider and a model, write the prompts, and it makes the call. The model list comes from the platform's model catalogue, so a model added there becomes selectable here without rebuilding a flow. The managed provider runs on platform credentials, so you bind nothing; anthropic, openai and google are called directly with your organization's own key, bound as a secret and never written into the template. Anything in ${braces} is filled from the data arriving at the node; if the user prompt is blank or names a field that did not arrive, the incoming data itself is sent. The tokens used are priced from the catalogue and recorded against the run. A wrong setting fails before any call is made, and a failed call or an answer with no text fails the run rather than passing an empty answer on.

Configure
- LLM Provider - managed (default, platform credentials), anthropic, openai or google.
- Model - a model of that provider, from the catalogue. gpt-5.2 by default.
- System Prompt - the standing instruction. "You are a helpful assistant." by default.
- User Prompt - the message. ${prompt} by default, meaning the prompt field of the incoming data.
- Temperature - 0 to 2, 0.7 by default. Not sent to models that refuse it.
- Max Tokens - ceiling on the reply length, 4000 by default.
- Reasoning Effort - low, medium or high, for managed reasoning models. Blank leaves it to the model.
- API Key - bind the organization secret holding the provider key; not needed for managed.

In and out In: data whose fields fill the ${...} placeholders, or a JSON artifact to send as it is. Out: the reply, the model and provider that answered, the input and output token counts, and a one-line summary of the call, as data and as a JSON artifact.

Use it when
- Any step of a flow needs text generated, summarised, classified or rewritten.
- You want to switch models or providers later without rebuilding the flow.
- You need the token cost of a step recorded against the run.
component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: agent
name: LLM Request
description: >
  Sends one prompt to a model in the platform's model catalogue and returns
  the reply with its token counts. The managed provider runs on platform
  credentials through perceivo.managed_service.ai; anthropic, openai and
  google are called directly with the api_key secret. ${field} placeholders in
  the prompts are filled from request_data, and the token cost is recorded on
  the run at the catalogue rate. A misconfigured node raises before any call;
  a failed call or an empty reply raises and fails the run.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    # The artifact is read only as a fallback for the user message, behind a
    # None guard, so it is welcome but never required.
    artifact_type_input: optional(json)
    artifact_type_output: json
    # Placeholders read request_data by whatever name the prompts give, so no
    # key is required. `prompt` is the one the default User Prompt reads.
    request_data:
      prompt: string (optional) - The user message, read by the default User Prompt ${prompt}.
    response_data:
      response: string - The model's reply.
      tokens_in: integer - Prompt tokens consumed.
      tokens_out: integer - Reply tokens consumed, including any reasoning tokens.
      model: string - The model that answered.
      provider: string - The provider that answered.
      conversation_log: string - One-line summary of the call.

required_secrets:
  - name: api_key
    label: API Key
    required: false
    description: Provider API key. Required for anthropic, openai and google; unused for the managed provider.

input_parameters:
  - name: provider
    type: select
    label: LLM Provider
    options: [managed, anthropic, openai, google]
    default: managed
    required: true
    description: managed runs on platform credentials; any other provider needs the api_key secret.
  - name: model
    type: select
    label: Model
    default: gpt-5.2 ($2/$8 per 1M)
    required: true
    description: A model of the chosen provider, from the platform's model catalogue.
  - name: user_prompt
    type: text_long
    label: User Prompt
    default: ${prompt}
    description: The message. ${field} or ${nested.field} is filled from incoming data. When blank, or when a named field is missing, the incoming artifact or data is sent instead.
  - name: system_prompt
    type: text_long
    label: System Prompt
    default: You are a helpful assistant.
    required: true
    description: Standing instruction for the model. ${field} placeholders are filled from incoming data.
  - name: temperature
    type: number
    label: Temperature
    default: 0.7
    constraints: {min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.1}
    description: Lower is more predictable, higher more varied. Not sent to models that refuse it.
  - name: max_tokens
    type: integer
    label: Max Tokens
    default: 4000
    constraints: {min: 100, max: 100000}
    description: Ceiling on the reply length. Reasoning models spend part of it thinking.
  - name: reasoning_effort
    type: select
    label: Reasoning Effort
    options: [low, medium, high]
    default: ""
    description: Managed reasoning models only. Hidden reasoning tokens count against Max Tokens, so a high effort with a small budget returns no text. Leave blank to let the model decide.
component.name: LLM REQUEST (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)

prompt.description: The user message, read by the default User Prompt ${prompt}.

tokens_out.description: Reply tokens consumed, including any reasoning tokens.

component.short_description: Sends a prompt to any model in the platform's model catalogue - managed or with your own key - and returns the reply with its token counts.
